text_block_list.text: —In the library.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy. Could you lend me a book?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
P-P-President...!? Welcome... Yes, what 
kind of book are you looking for?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The chronicles of the Twinkle Series. 
—"The Chapter of Tamamo Cross."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The umamusume "Tamamo Cross" and her 
Trainer achieved tremendous 
accomplishments during their first three 
years.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That alone is noteworthy, but what should 
be recorded even further—is what happened 
in the years that followed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaat? The "Eternal Big Three"?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Is that what you guys are called?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Apparently so. Between me, who was raised 
in Kasamatsu, and...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Born and raised in Oi! Bathed in the 
waters of the Keihin Canal, this is Inari 
One!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Along with Super Creek. Somehow, people 
often see the three of us as a close-knit 
trio~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a minute. I ain't joking around! 
What gives with this "Eternal Big Three" 
stuff when you're leaving me out?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even faster than that is the "White 
Lightning"! If ya wanna brag, do it after 
ya beat me!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you bet! I'm gonna beat 'em black 
and blue, so they better be ready!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume achieving greatness one after 
another. That excitement wasn't confined 
to Tracen Academy. Yes, that passion 
wasâ

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It would eventually reach far beyond the 
racecourse. In the end, it truly marked a 
turning point in history.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you know about the Twinkle Series? 
I've been seeing it everywhere lately.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap are 
amazing, right? I really want to go see 
them~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Even those who previously had no interest 
in racing began paying attention, and the 
excitement captured from a broad fan base 
will surely carry over to the next 
generation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross-san and Oguri Cap-san. Both 
defied public expectations despite coming 
from humble beginnings...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful. I shall certainly do the 
same. —Next year is our year, Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...! We're making our debut too...! 
Someday, alongside Oguri Cap-san...!

Heheh, is it about time for my turn? The 
only one who can pass those amazing 
Umamusume is—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's gotta be me, right♪ Aaaall right!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross's hoofprints are not merely 
the strides of an ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Her monumental leap forward heralded the 
beginning of a golden age in the Twinkle 
Series.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, her existence is recorded in the 
history books as follows:

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Alongside the "White Lightning" who forged 
a new era. —And so, the story continues.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, Trainer. It's tough day in and day 
out, eh? So many folks gathered, it's 
total fever pitch.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Still, thanks to that, I'm able to run 
full of energy like this. Thanks a bunch!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, let's keep giving it our all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The reason I can shine is thanks to you, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom, are you watching? Thank you for 
entrusting your dream to me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The only reason I'm here today is because 
the two of them gave me life.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Because you never forgot how to dream even 
in the hardest times, I'm standing right 
here today. And so—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The racecourse is packed with fans today 
too. At first, I didn't really get what 
fans were all about, but now I understand.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fans ain't just customers. They watch us, 
cheer for us, and carry on our memories.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run with them. Even if there comes a 
day when I can't run anymore, I'll still 
be dashing alongside them..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Fans go and tell their friends and kids, 
y'know? 'There was an Umamusume who 
refused to give in to adversity.'

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I promise ya. No matter what, I'll always 
be my mama and papa's... dream.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll just keep on running. It doesn't 
matter where. Whether on the racetrack or 
anywhere else, I'm totally free.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The trail of dreams I've carved will never 
fade. It's a dream's lightning—echoing 
hundreds of years into the future.
